name: Dynamic Vero 1-Person Compact Ultra Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna, Pacific Cedar, Honey Dark Stain, DYN-1201-01 Elite
description: Product Description Experience premium infrared wellness in a compact luxury design with the Dynamic Vero 1-Person Compact Ultra Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna. Crafted from environmentally-friendly Pacific Cedar with an elegant Honey Dark Stain finish, the DYN-1201-01 Elite combines advanced infrared heating technology, sophisticated craftsmanship, and modern wellness features to create a spa-inspired retreat within your home. Designed for smaller spaces without compromising comfort or performance, the Dynamic Vero utilizes 4 Dynamic PureTech™ Ultra Low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels engineered to deliver deep, evenly distributed warmth while maintaining EMF levels between 3-5MG measured 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels. FAR infrared heat is designed to support relaxation, circulation, muscle recovery, and overall wellness while creating a soothing and rejuvenating environment. Its compact 1-person footprint makes the sauna ideal for apartments, wellness rooms, home gyms, walk-in closets, master bathrooms, or dedicated relaxation spaces. The Pacific Cedar wood construction offers excellent durability, thermal efficiency, and natural beauty, while the Honey Dark Stain finish enhances the sauna’s refined contemporary appearance. The sauna’s sleek modern design is complemented by a clear tempered glass door, creating an open and inviting atmosphere while maintaining a premium luxury aesthetic. Inside, integrated chromotherapy color lighting and a dedicated red light therapy feature help create a calming spa-inspired environment designed to elevate relaxation and rejuvenation. For entertainment and convenience, the sauna includes Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary connectivity paired with built-in speakers, allowing you to enjoy music, podcasts, or meditation sessions during every sauna experience. Interior LED control panels provide intuitive operation and precise temperature adjustments. The Dynamic Vero requires a dedicated 120V/20AMP non-GFCI electrical receptacle and breaker for reliable heating performance and is designed exclusively for indoor residential installation. Combining Ultra Low EMF infrared technology, premium wellness lighting, compact luxury design, and elegant Pacific Cedar craftsmanship, the Dynamic Vero 1-Person Infrared Sauna delivers a sophisticated wellness experience designed for modern home living. Key Features Compact full 1-person indoor infrared sauna Ultra Low EMF FAR infrared heating system, between 3-5MG 4 Dynamic PureTech™ FAR infrared carbon heating panels Environmentally-friendly Pacific Cedar construction Honey Dark Stain finish Clear tempered glass door Interior chromotherapy color lighting system Integrated red light therapy feature Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary connectivity Built-in speaker system Interior LED control panels Dedicated 120V/20AMP electrical connection Compact space-saving design Indoor residential installation Technical Specifications General Model: DYN-1201-01 Elite Brand: Dynamic Saunas Sauna Type: FAR Infrared Sauna EMF Rating: Ultra Low EMF, between 3-5MG Capacity: 1 Person Installation Type: Indoor Use Only Finish: Honey Dark Stain Sauna Collection: Dynamic Elite Ultra Low EMF Saunas Product Dimensions & Weight Exterior Dimensions: 32" W x 34" D x 67" H Product Weight: 145 lbs Heating System Heating Technology: FAR Infrared Carbon Heating Panels Heater Quantity: 4 Heating Panels Heating Elements: 4 Dynamic PureTech™ Ultra Low EMF FAR Infrared Carbon Panels EMF Level: Between 3-5MG measured 2 to 3 inches from heating panels Performance Ideal Operating Temperature Range: 118°F to 132°F Maximum Temperature: Up to 140°F Electrical Requirements Electrical Service: Dedicated 120V / 20AMP Non-GFCI Receptacle and Breaker Voltage: 120V Only Installation Requirement: Dedicated Outlet Required Recommendation: Consult a Certified Electrician Not Compatible With: 220V/240V Electrical Service Materials & Build Wood Type: Pacific Cedar Finish: Honey Dark Stain Glass Type: Clear Tempered Glass Door Controls & Features Interior LED Control Panels Interior Chromotherapy Color Lighting Red Light Therapy Feature Bluetooth Audio Connectivity MP3 Auxiliary Connection Built-In Speakers Shipping & Packaging Delivery This item ships curbside only and is delivered on a pallet by a freight carrier. Packaging Details Number of Boxes: 1 Shipping Method: LTL Freight Individual Box Dimensions & Weights Box A Dimensions: 70" W x 14" D x 44" H Weight: 161 lbs Pallet Dimensions Pallet Size: 70" W x 16" D x 40" H Pallet Weight: 225 lbs Why Choose This Sauna? The Dynamic Vero 1-Person Compact Ultra Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna is perfect for homeowners seeking advanced infrared wellness technology in a sleek compact design. Its Ultra Low EMF heating system delivers deep therapeutic warmth while maintaining EMF levels between 3-5MG, creating a comfortable and wellness-focused sauna experience. With chromotherapy lighting, integrated red light therapy, Bluetooth audio connectivity, and elegant Pacific Cedar craftsmanship, the Dynamic Vero transforms smaller indoor spaces into sophisticated personal wellness retreats.
